veranderings.voor: bied 'n muis en 'n padda haar hulp aan
veranderings.na: bied 'n muis en 'n padda aan om haar te help
veranderings.rede: 'bied haar hulp aan' can be read as Mpunzikazi offering her own help; the rewording makes clear the mouse and frog offer to help her.

'hulle' directly follows 'Die ram sien hulle kom' (the leopard and jackal), so 'hulle kleintjie' can be misread as theirs; 'sy' points to the ram, and 'buitentoe' is the more idiomatic direction adverb.
